A BETTER START

What helps us plan your project.

A few practical details make the first conversation more useful. You can share them now or prepare them before reaching out.

01

Location & climate

Where will the home go, and will it be used year-round or seasonally?

02

Use & quantity

Is this for a resort, rental, business or private living? How many units are planned?

03

Site readiness

Consider vehicle access, ground conditions, utilities and any local approvals.

04

Timing & scope

Share your target schedule and which finishes or fittings matter most.

Final specifications, site requirements and delivery terms are confirmed in a written proposal for each project.
